title: App is somewhat useful but laggy & NOT working properly
body: This is the kind of app I'm looking for which allows you to gamify anything and create main and sub-tasks. However, I couldn't add any habits but the dailies and to-dos are working fine with a HUGE delay. Whenever I'm changing my avatar or adding a new task in dailies/to-dos, it has delays and laggy/buggy. Due to this, I can't give a higher ranking. I like the features of this app but it's too laggy! I always have to reopen the app to see my newly added tasks. This is very INCONVENIENT!
author: Mew&Espurr
